content.text:
This is a PROTAC-type molecule: an EGFR-binding quinazoline warhead, a linker, and a thalidomide-derived (pomalidomide-type) cereblon ligand.

**Warhead.** The quinazoline carries a 3-chloro-4-fluoroanilino group at C4, a methoxy at C7, and an amide NH at C6. The amide is a crotonamide: NC(=O)/C=C/CN, with the terminal CH2 attached to a piperazine nitrogen. The double bond is drawn trans.

**Linker.** The other piperazine nitrogen carries C(=O)CCOCCOCCOCCOCCN. Reading the chain from the carbonyl: CH2, CH2, O, CH2CH2, O, CH2CH2, O, CH2CH2, O, CH2CH2, NH. That gives four ether oxygens.

**Cereblon ligand.** The linker NH is attached to C4 of the phthalimide (isoindoline-1,3-dione). The imide nitrogen is bonded to C3 of a glutarimide (2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl). That carbon is drawn with plain bonds, so no stereochemistry is assigned.

**Assembling the SMILES.**
- Quinazoline: c1nc(Nc2ccc(F)c(Cl)c2)c2cc(NC(=O)/C=C/CN3CCN(CC3)C(=O)CCOCCOCCOCCOCCNc3cccc4C(=O)N(C5CCC(=O)NC5=O)C(=O)c34)c(OC)cc2n1
- The quinazoline ring reads n1cnc2cc(OC)c(NC(=O)...)cc2c1N-Ar, with C4 bearing the anilino group, C6 the amide and C7 the OMe. It is written as COc1cc2ncnc(Nc3ccc(F)c(Cl)c3)c2cc1NC(=O)/C=C/CN1CCN(CC1)C(=O)CCOCCOCCOCCOCCNc1cccc2C(=O)N(C3CCC(=O)NC3=O)C(=O)c12.

SMILES: COc1cc2ncnc(Nc3ccc(F)c(Cl)c3)c2cc1NC(=O)/C=C/CN1CCN(CC1)C(=O)CCOCCOCCOCCOCCNc1cccc2C(=O)N(C3CCC(=O)NC3=O)C(=O)c12
